text:
samir: FYI customer Arboreal flagged intermittent hallucinations and answer flip-flops after we pushed the 8-bit quantized variant of their 14b model this morning. Rolling back reduced errors but they want root cause and plan. :warning:
maria: timeline? which rollout exactly? can you paste the deploy id or config? :eyes:
samir: deploy id rdw-deploy-8732, quant profile q8f-v2, batch_size=4, continuous-batching enabled. happened ~09:10 UTC. customer logs attached in ticket #ARB-412.
lucas: saw similar failure pattern in our nightly smoke for that profile — higher token-level perplexity spikes and occasional context truncation artifacts. logging saved under /mnt/quant-smoke/2024-11-01/rdw-deploy-8732.log
jane: can you paste the minimal repro prompt that flipped? I can run locally if small.
samir: pasted below (sanitized):
```
User: "List the five most populated US states, with population counts."
Model: "California, Texas, New York, Florida, Illinois"
Later: asked again with same prompt -> returned "California, Texas, Florida, Ohio, Georgia" (changed ordering & dropped NY).
```
maria: mismatch between runs suggests non-determinism introduced by quant kernels or cache invalidation. Also check KV cache alignment codepath when using continuous batching.
lucas: quick checks I ran:
- run unquantized float32 on same seed -> stable outputs across runs
- run q8f-v1 -> slightly noisy but not flip on top-5
- run q8f-v2 (deployed) -> flips in 3/50 runs for that prompt
- perf: latency improved ~12% but token-likelihood variance up ~8%
ops-bot: smoke-test job rdw-smoke-8732 finished: 12/50 failures, avg latency 142ms, 95p 310ms.
jane: hypothesis: quantization scaling for attention softmax or fused kernels rounding causing tiny score shifts that reorder top tokens in borderline cases.
maria: agree. also want to rule out prompt preprocessing or whitespace normalization differences in the dedicated stack vs local. can someone run diff between tokenizer outputs?
lucas: ran tokenizer diff: identical bytes for this prompt. so likely numeric precision. I can reproduce with minified test harness.
samir: priority for customer — they want either stable quality or clear rollback plan. we've rolled back to float32 earlier but need a safe path: do we pin q8f-v1, or adjust batching policy?
jane: short-term: pin to q8f-v1 for Arboreal and schedule a canary for q8f-v2 with stricter eval gates. medium-term: add candidate evals that measure top-k stability across 100 seeds and realistic prompts (not just perplexity).
maria: add checklist for triage: 1) reproduce locally with same model+profile 2) run deterministic seed tests (100 runs) 3) measure top-k stability and token-likelihood variance 4) check KV cache offsets with continuous batching enabled 5) run kernel-level float comparators (FP32 vs quant emulation) 6) if unstable, fallback to previous quant profile or adjust calibration table.
lucas: I ran FP emulation (simulate quant by casting and running full kernels) and saw similar flips — suggests calibration table needs update for this model.
ops-bot: opened issue INF-1129: "q8f-v2 calibration drift on arboreal-14b" assigned to lucas. ETA 48h.
samir: customer-facing message draft: "We've observed instability with the q8f-v2 quant profile on your model; we've rolled you to q8f-v1 while we investigate numeric calibration and KV cache interactions. We'll follow up with mitigation ETA." anyone want to tweak?
jane: add that we're running extended stability suites and will share test logs by EOD.
maria: action items: lucas validate calibration + propose new table; jane expand stability prompts + run 1k-sample test; samir coordinate customer comms and confirm rollback; i'll own change to canary gating and update rollout config.
lucas: starting calibration runs now, will post results and diff plots to the thread. linking notebook: https://redwood-internal/run/INF-1129/calib-notebook (private)
samir: thanks. if anyone spots perf regressions or other customers impacted, ping me. I'll update the ticket and the on-call rotation. :thumbsup:
